title: Transepithelial accelerated corneal crosslinking for keratoconus eyes with maximum keratometry values larger than 58 diopters

license.statement: CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 (article <license>: 'Creative Commons Attribution-Non Commercial-No Derivatives License 4.0 (CCBY-NC-ND)')

groups.description: Group A: progressive keratoconus with preoperative Kmax of 58.0 D or more (group defined before treatment); transepithelial (epithelium-on) accelerated pulsed CXL (0.1% then 0.25% riboflavin, UVA 45 mW/cm2 for 5 min 20 s, pulsed illumination), one surgeon, prospective recruitment in 2017; same-session cataract surgery not mentioned.

Group B: progressive keratoconus with preoperative Kmax below 58.0 D (group defined before treatment); same transepithelial accelerated pulsed CXL protocol and surgeon; same-session cataract surgery not mentioned.

series.notes: Mean ± SD (Table 2 caption). Columns Preop, 1 mo, 3 mo, 6 mo and 1 y. Snellen acuity converted to logMAR for statistical analysis (Statistical Analyses). Per-visit n not reported; the 1-year proportions in Results are given over 20 eyes.

Mean ± SD (Table 3 caption). Columns Preop, 1 mo, 3 mo, 6 mo and 1 y. Snellen acuity converted to logMAR for statistical analysis (Statistical Analyses). Per-visit n not reported; the 1-year proportions in Results are given over 21 eyes.

exclusions.what: Proportions of eyes gaining 2 or more lines of CDVA or UDVA (Results, Figure 1)
exclusions.reason: Proportions and lines gained are not admissible (protocol inclusion 4).
Uncorrected acuity is not admissible (protocol inclusion 1).

notes: Table 1 (R8) also gives the preoperative CDVA of both groups; the series cite the Preop column of Tables 2 and 3.
The whole cohort (41 eyes of 41 patients) is not tabulated as a single series; only the two Kmax subgroups are, and both are extracted.
No outcome-based or complete-case restriction is stated; the 1-year proportions in Results are given over all 20 and 21 eyes.
The 1-day visit is not tabulated for CDVA.
Spherical equivalent, flat, steep and mean keratometry, Kmax, thinnest corneal thickness and endothelial cell density are tabulated (Tables 2 and 3); not extracted (schema 1.0.0).
No investigational arm is declared; both groups are patient-condition subgroups of the same treatment (role control).
